# Neural_Manifold_Embedding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The mapping of interbrain connectivity patterns onto low-dimensional manifolds to capture intrinsic geometric relationships between distributed neural populations. Enables efficient in-network representation of collective neural dynamics, supporting neuromorphic hardware that operates on manifold-based computations.
